verdict.rationale: Drata's docs say it connects tools, including on-premise and custom systems, to automate evidence collection. Connections, custom connections and monitoring tests back this up. The open-source Drata Agent reads endpoint security settings automatically, and a community comment notes that directory users show up as noncompliant in the dashboard, which suggests continuous machine-gathered monitoring. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of scheduled or recurring collection cadence, documentation that artifacts are timestamped and replace screenshots/CSV exports, and independent hands-on corroboration of artifact quality.
